why: Both land on the key's hedgehog (most convenient drugstores, profit per customer visit) and the same brutal facts, but Analysis 2 ties it more explicitly to dense clusters on the best corners and a pharmacy-centred format. Analysis 2 also commits harder to the key's stop-doing decision, with planned divestment of the free-standing restaurants, a timed sale of the discount stores and a firm phase-out of the lunch counters, where Analysis 1 mostly pauses and reviews.
